selection_notes: Selected corpus contains four complete candidate snapshots, four review/feedback series, original instructions, original frozen examiner, broker operation journal, predecessor result records and both recorded peer runs.
The verified full original archive is preserved separately and is authoritative for omitted events, protocol schemas and command output.
Executable-looking .py filenames have a .txt suffix; source bytes are otherwise identical; every copy has mode 0644; no archive member was imported or run.

We omit session/events.jsonl and tool_results.json, nested tar files, process stdout/stderr, canary/private sentinel files and full protocol schemas. These omissions limit reinspection but do not erase the source archive pin.
The S1 review refers to a separate computed JSON that was not among the supplied publication uploads; the raw records and S1 text are present.

source_archive.original_manifest_verification: Verified all 2077 SHA-256 values, lengths, modes and coverage; MANIFEST.json excludes itself.
